notes: Scout 2026-11-24: read homepage, about us and where to buy pages; the online store (good-hope-farmstead.localline.ca) could not be opened, and the old goodhopefarmstead.grazecart.com site shows only a maintenance notice. Beef is grass-fed and grass-finished; pork, chicken, lamb and mutton are described as pasture-raised on non-GMO feed. Free home delivery on orders of $50 or more: Wednesdays to the Frederick / Mt. Airy / Westminster area, Saturdays to the Rockville / Bethesda / Crofton / Bowie area. Preorder pickup at the Rockville Farmers Market (Saturdays May 16 to Nov 21, 2026) and Friday curbside pickup on the farm; no on-farm store. No shipping stated. Bulk shares not seen on the pages read (store not reachable); Verifier: check the store for quarters or halves. Maryland's Best also lists delivery to Montgomery, Prince George's, Carroll and Frederick Counties; not used here.
